title: International institutions and national change
shared: These studies distinguish an international institution’s powers and decisions from the national actions needed to change money, rules or operating arrangements. The country and monetary views show which particular function is changing.
keep_distinct: Keep treaty authority, forum agendas, recommendations, national implementation, membership, assessments, funding shares, votes, loan conditions and operating substitution separate; percentages with different denominators are not interchangeable.
